steps.label: Prompt
steps.text:
Make a 40-second launch film for [your product], 16:9 at 1920x1080, from the "27-doc-to-drawn-video" template in lumian2015/opus-5-5-video-templates (MIT, rendered with HyperFrames).

Setup: clone https://github.com/lumian2015/opus-5-5-video-templates into ~/.claude/skills/opus-5-5-video-templates, then run `npx hyperframes@0.8.96 doctor` and fix anything it reports (it needs Node.js 22 or newer, FFmpeg and Chrome).

The film, scene by scene:
1. a tilted, out-of-focus close-up of a textbook page; key words get highlighter marks
2. the page becomes an open book; pages flip faster and faster while 'Pages. and pages. and pages.' builds up; the book closes and spins away
3. dark: the three-stroke mark draws itself, the wordmark slides out with an RGB split, the tagline tracks in
4. the paragraph returns with its highlights, greys out, and dissolves into a drawn ocean
5. a hand-drawn water-cycle diagram draws itself stroke by stroke with handwritten labels
6. the drawing becomes a video in a player card with karaoke captions and new labels
7. a script editor: read it, fix a word, generate; the button opens a dark iris
8. the same sentence rolls through 19 narration languages with a counter
9. an orb, a spinning ring of style thumbnails, two example videos, a 9:16 crop that pans
10. a 4x4 grid of videos, 'Whiteboard or motion.', then a dot field with a rolling counter
11. the dots stream into the mark; light end card with tagline, button and domain

Before you change anything, learn [your product] from [your product URL] and ask me only for what you cannot find: its name, what it does in one line, the copy each scene needs, and two or three brand colours as #rrggbb. The demo brand, names, prices, numbers, ratings and quotes are placeholders: replace every one with something true for my product, or remove it. Never ship a made-up number or testimonial.

Then:
1. `node ~/.claude/skills/opus-5-5-video-templates/scripts/new-video.mjs 27-doc-to-drawn-video my-video`
2. `node ~/.claude/skills/opus-5-5-video-templates/scripts/vars.mjs my-video` to list the variables.
3. Write values.json, keeping each value close to its default's length and format (the same number of |-separated items, plain numbers where the default is a number), then apply it with `node ~/.claude/skills/opus-5-5-video-templates/scripts/vars.mjs my-video values.json`.
4. `cd my-video && npx hyperframes@0.8.96 snapshot --at 1,13,27,39`, look at every frame, and fix any text that overflows or any colour that is hard to read.
5. `npx hyperframes@0.8.96 render -f 60 -q high -w 4 -o out.mp4`, then watch it through once before you hand it over.

Template notes: In para, [g:word], [b:word] and [p:word] mark green, blue and pink highlights. Drawing labels take | for line breaks and {b:word} for blue. The 19 translations live in the LANGS array (edit them together if the sentence changes); Cyrillic, Greek, Vietnamese and Devanagari glyphs come from bundled Inter subsets and Noto Sans Devanagari. The diagram and the example thumbnails are SVG drawings in ILL and buildBoard(). The counter rolls up to the videos value; keep it true or remove it.
